prior_candidate: The GPU-plus-link pressure candidate in protocol_dev.json failed its 300-second C1_single go rule and is frozen at git commit 915287c.
new_candidate: Keep canonical edges and frozen static slow-link detours. Admit another legal compute edge only if the canonical successor's observed link-release wait plus this request's transfer time exceeds the candidate edge's corresponding link pressure by more than 154 times the positive relative marginal decode-batch work. GPU-release wait is excluded from the gate; the frozen M3 ranking still uses it.
units: All pressures and the fragmentation penalty are seconds; 154 is the previously recorded pooled seed-100 output median, never this request's future length.
fixed_inputs: M2 layout, M1 DAG, M3 costs/ties, simulator, trace seed 100, executed-layer KV admission and public 1000-token output bound are identical across comparison cells.
go_rule: At least one added detour is selected. On BOTH high-load conditions, dynamic_link relative to static has throughput >= -0.5% and P95 TPOT <= +2%; at least one high-load condition has lower P95 TPOT. If it fails, no formal runs.
counterfactual: dynamic_link_no_batch removes only the marginal batch penalty while keeping link-relief calculation and M3 ranking. It is explanatory, not a candidate eligible for formal selection.
low_load_control: If high-load go rule passes, run C1_single at 350 offered token/s with the same seed/duration, static versus dynamic_link; report extra paths and any degradation as a negative control.
formal_gate: Write and commit a new protocol.json with exact seeds, windows, comparisons, failure handling, and frozen code/config hashes before launching any formal window. The old candidate's development outcomes are not pooled with the new one.
